elements.text: At Assembly, we understand that the right lighting can make all the difference. Especially when it comes to creating a warm, inviting space that reflects your unique style and personality.

elements.name: PElement
elements.text: That's why we wanted to share some lighting and lighting design tips with you to help you brighten up your home or office.

elements.name: PElement
elements.text: Instead of relying on one bright overhead light, consider layering your lighting by adding lamps, sconces, and other types of lighting fixtures. This will create a more dynamic and interesting lighting scheme.

elements.name: PElement
elements.text: Color temperature refers to the hue of the light, which can range from warm yellow to cool blue. Consider the mood you want to create and the colors in your space when selecting the color temperature of your bulbs.

elements.name: PElement
elements.text: Use lighting to highlight key features in your space, such as artwork, architectural details, or plants. This will draw the eye and create visual interest.

elements.name: PElement
elements.text: We offer a range of lighting fixtures and design services to help you create the perfect lighting scheme for your space.

elements.name: PElement
elements.text: Whether you're looking for a statement pendant or need help designing a custom lighting plan, our team of lighting experts is here to help.
